card.name: Digits inside years and measurements
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly the 8 in a year like 1980s or 1989, or the first digit of a number before a unit such as dB or dpi. It is in general web text, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Year digit
modes.description: The third digit 8 in a 1980s year, or the 0 in 2015.

modes.label: Number before a unit
modes.description: The first digit or the space before a number followed by dB, dB gain or dpi.

card.plain: It fires on a digit inside a year, especially the 8 in the 1980s, or on a number before a sound or resolution unit.
